summary: Independent visual review confirmed the recognizable straps, heel loops, open toes and continuous dark tread. The small rest patch and the branched tread patch in run 4 disappeared after subdivision. The straps still render paler than the reference. The tread outline shows facets, with dark triangular folds near the front-strap anchors and a crumpled outer fastener. At run 4 the toe bumper forms a steep ramp and the instep tip points upward.
